scenes.line1: How do websites send real-time updates?
scenes.say: How do websites push live updates? Which technology should you use for different real-time scenarios?

scenes.label: WebSockets
scenes.sub: Full-duplex, persistent connection for real-time chat and gaming.
scenes.say: WebSockets create a persistent link, letting both client and server talk freely. Great for chat apps or multiplayer games.

scenes.label: SSE
scenes.sub: Server pushes updates to browser over HTTP. One-way only.
scenes.say: Server-Sent Events let the server push updates to the browser, but only one way. Perfect for live feeds or notifications.
Pick WebSockets for two-way, real-time communication. Go with Server-Sent Events when you just need the server to send updates.

scenes.question: Can SSE send data from client to server?
scenes.right: No, SSE only lets the server push data to the client. For two-way, use WebSockets.
scenes.say: Here's a common interview trap: Can Server-Sent Events send data back to the server? Remember, it's one-way only. If you need two-way, use WebSockets.
